What GG Offers •     Training Budget: A dedicated training budget to help you upskill and grow in your career. •     Paid Certifications: Professional certifications fully funded by Galaxy Guard. •     Mentoring: One-on-one mentoring from experienced, veteran engineers. •     Clear Promotion Path: A structured certification path with a promotion on successful completion. •     Project Exposure: Placement on live project work to build hands-on, real-world experience. •     Team Culture: A collaborative, supportive team environment where people help each other succeed.

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DevOps/SRE based in Brazil. This role is focused on building and maintaining highly reliable, scalable, and automated cloud infrastructure. You will work across Kubernetes, AWS/GCP, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, networking, and observability. Your work will directly contribute to system availability, performance, resilience, and operational efficiency. You will automate infrastructure and deployment processes while establishing consistent and scalable environments. The position combines hands-on engineering, proactive monitoring, incident response, and continuous reliability improvements. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams to strengthen operational practices and enable dependable software delivery. It is an opportunity to work with experienced professionals, modern technologies, and an innovative product with meaningful impact. Accountabilities Administer and optimize Kubernetes clusters and cloud infrastructure across AWS and/or GCP, with a focus on availability, performance, scalability, and reliability. Ensure operational reliability across the technology stack, from networking and infrastructure through software development and continuous delivery processes. Build and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability capabilities to enable proactive issue detection and rapid incident response. Automate deployments and infrastructure management to improve efficiency, scalability, consistency, and environment standardization. Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to streamline and improve the software delivery lifecycle. Continuously strengthen system resilience, reliability, and operational maturity. Collaborate with engineering teams to promote high-availability architectures and strong operational and infrastructure practices. Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, deployment, and production issues and contribute to preventative improvements. Requirements Solid professional experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including troubleshooting, cluster management, and scalability. Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or Ansible, including environment segregation and automation. Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP cloud services, including VPC, IAM, load balancers, S3, RDS, configuration, and automation practices. Knowledge of networking concepts and technologies, including firewall configuration, access controls, and network policies. Intermediate to advanced Python skills for operational automation and scripting. Intermediate Linux administration skills, including server management and network troubleshooting. Familiarity with access-management best practices, user administration, and least-privilege principles. Experience with CI/CD in highly available environments is a strong advantage. Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms is desirable. Experience administering and optimizing SQL and NoSQL databases is a plus. Familiarity with Keycloak for authentication and identity management is beneficial. Experience administering Java-based solutions such as Apache NiFi is an advantage. Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with a proactive approach to reliability and operational challenges. Benefits Full-time employment under a CLT contract. Flexible Caju benefits card with a monthly allowance of R$ 1,033.50. Fully company-subsidized medical and dental insurance through Bradesco, with no copayment. Life insurance. Transportation allowance, subject to the legally applicable 6% employee contribution. Wellhub (formerly Gympass) partnership. Access to Psicologia Viva and Conexa Saúde partnerships. Birthday month day off. Fruit table for employees working in the office-based model. Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals from the financial services market. Continuous opportunities to develop technical skills and learn modern technologies and engineering practices. Opportunity to contribute to an innovative project designed to positively impact customers' financial lives and create new ways of doing business.
